title: Axios reports the FTC sent investigative demands to OpenAI and Anthropic
friendlyTitle: A US regulator has asked OpenAI and Anthropic for safety files
summary: Axios reported that the US Federal Trade Commission on Wednesday sent civil investigative demands to OpenAI and Anthropic, citing a person familiar with the probe. The demands are said to run more than 50 pages and to seek documents on safety incidents, safeguards, marketing and privacy policies. OpenAI said safety remains a priority and that it will engage constructively.
friendlySummary: Axios reports that the Federal Trade Commission has formally asked OpenAI and Anthropic for documents about safety incidents, safeguards, marketing and privacy. The report relies on a person familiar with the probe. OpenAI said it will cooperate.
whyItMatters: An investigative demand is a request for evidence, not a finding that either company broke the law. If the inquiry continues, customers may see more incident disclosure and clearer claims about what these products can safely do.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This is an investigation, not a court ruling. It may lead to clearer public information about incidents and product claims.
